اختتموا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَتَمُوا (iḵtatamū) /ix.ta.ta.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# اُخْتُتِمُوا (uḵtutimū) /ux.tu.ti.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# اِخْتَتِمُوا (iḵtatimū) /ix.ta.ti.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
